summary.text: No. You cannot voluntarily top up only your Ordinary Account. Other top-up choices are available.

details.heading: Available top-up choices
details.body: You can top up your Special or Retirement Account only, your MediSave Account only, or all 3 CPF accounts.

details.heading: Special or Retirement Account
details.body: This is under the Retirement Sum Topping Up Scheme. Tax relief is available.

details.heading: MediSave or all accounts
details.body: You can top up your MediSave Account only, or all 3 CPF accounts.

example_phrasings: Can I voluntarily top-up to my Ordinary Account only?
Can I top up only my Ordinary Account?
Can I add money to just my Ordinary Account?

sources.page_title: Can I voluntarily top-up to my Ordinary Account only?

quotes.text: Voluntary top-ups cannot be made solely to the Ordinary Account.
You can make voluntary top-ups to your:
Special / Retirement Account only under the Retirement Sum Topping Up Scheme (RSTU) (tax relief available).
